shadow-authority.rationale: One core model owns factor, state, cycle, seam, timing, and direction-aware epsilon semantics at all four exact boundaries.

gameplay-consequences.rationale: Solar production follows direct daylight and source-local smooth sensor penalties preserve Compact and Choir minima alongside power degradation.

launch-intelligence.rationale: Game prevalidates complete event eligibility while Effects and audio preserve global deep-shadow launches; hidden day launches retain existing fog and range.

strategic-contacts.rationale: Approved contacts derive solely from live hostile state independently of LOS, exclude ordinary entities, and return readonly frozen collections and entries.

authority-ai.rationale: Strategic contacts never grant tactical visibility, selection, or conventional firing authority; AI routing remains separate from exact combat acquisition.

presentation-accessibility.rationale: HUD and minimap provide non-color timing, hidden-contact outlines, visible category summaries, category-aware ARIA, and 1280x720 Low browser coverage.

persistence-regression.rationale: Save continuation, focused suites, LS-07 regressions, full lint/build/unit checks, and the veteran-mirror core cohort pass on the final snapshot.

scope.rationale: No strategic camera, remembered fog, transport, campaign, victory, or save-schema expansion was introduced, and all material consumers are source-bound.
